newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index little changed.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index little changed.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was up 0.18 points, or 0.26 percent, to 69.42 points after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30-share index provisionally closed down 22.12 points at 3,040.38 points.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 16.01 percent after 14.95 percent on Wednesday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
